### <a name="input_private_link_service_connection_state"></a> [private\_link\_service\_connection\_state](#input\_private\_link\_service\_connection\_state)

Description: Approval state of the private endpoint connection.

- `status`           - (Required) Connection status: 'Approved', 'Pending', or 'Rejected'.
- `description`      - (Optional) Reason for the approval or rejection.
- `actions_required` - (Optional) Message indicating if changes on the service provider require updates on the consumer.

Type:

```hcl
    description      = optional(string, null)
    actions_required = optional(string, null)
  })
```
